{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicate patient_id
patient_counts = df['patient_id'].value_counts()
duplicates = patient_counts[patient_counts > 1].index

duplicate_rows = df[df['patient_id'].isin(duplicates)]

duplicate_summary = duplicate_rows[['patient_id', 'sample_seq', 'site', 'arm', 'biomarker_baseline', 'biomarker_final', 'responded']].sort_values(by=['patient_id', 'sample_seq'])

duplicate_summary.head(10)"}
